page: Running Hono on AWS Lambda serverless platform with Node.js 18+. Setup: CDK CLI for managing IAM Role, API Gateway, functions. Initialize with cdk init app -l typescript. Install hono, esbuild. Create lambda/index.ts entry. Adapter: hono/aws-lambda with handle() export. CDK stack configuration: NodejsFunction with entry, handler, runtime (NODEJS_22_X). FunctionUrl with authType NONE. Binary data support: Hono auto-encodes to base64 when Content-Type set. Access Lambda context: LambdaEvent, LambdaContext types via c.env binding. RequestContext via c.env.event.requestContext (v3.10.0+) or deprecated ApiGatewayRequestContext. Response streaming: streamHandle for response streaming mode with streamText helper and stream.writeln(). InvokeMode.RESPONSE_STREAM in FunctionUrl config. Questions: How do I set up Hono on AWS Lambda? How do I configure CDK? How do I deploy? How do I access Lambda context? How do I serve binary data? How do I implement streaming?

sections.manifest: AWS Lambda setup with CDK. Initialize: mkdir my-app, cd my-app, cdk init app -l typescript. Install: hono, esbuild. Create lambda/index.ts. Commands vary by package manager: npm i, yarn add, pnpm add, bun add. Project structure: lambda directory for handler code. Questions: How do I initialize AWS Lambda project? What packages do I need? How do I structure directories?

Hello World Lambda function. File: lambda/index.ts. Import: Hono, handle from 'hono/aws-lambda'. Create app: new Hono(). Define route: app.get('/', (c) => c.text('Hello Hono!')). Export: export const handler = handle(app). Minimal Hono on Lambda setup. Questions: What's the basic Lambda handler? How do I define routes? What do I export?

CDK deployment configuration. File: lib/my-app-stack.ts. Imports: cdk, Construct, lambda, NodejsFunction. Class: MyAppStack extends cdk.Stack. NodejsFunction config: entry ('lambda/index.ts'), handler ('handler'), runtime (lambda.Runtime.NODEJS_22_X). Add FunctionUrl: authType NONE. Output: CfnOutput displays URL. Deploy: cdk deploy command. Result: function deployed to AWS Lambda. Questions: How do I configure CDK stack? What's NodejsFunction? How do I add function URL? How do I deploy?

Binary data response support. Content-Type binary types trigger base64 encoding. Hono auto-encodes ArrayBufferLike to base64. Example: set Content-Type: 'image/png', return c.body(buffer). Use c.status(200) for explicit status. Benefits: automatic handling without manual base64. Questions: How do I serve binary data? Does Hono encode automatically? What Content-Types are binary?

Access AWS Lambda objects via bindings. Types: LambdaEvent, LambdaContext from 'hono/aws-lambda'. Bindings type: { event: LambdaEvent, lambdaContext: LambdaContext }. Hono type: new Hono<{ Bindings: Bindings }>. Access via c.env: c.env.event.isBase64Encoded, c.env.lambdaContext.awsRequestId. Use case: logging, context-specific logic. Questions: How do I access Lambda event? How do I access Lambda context? What properties are available?

RequestContext access via LambdaEvent. Modern (v3.10.0+): c.env.event.requestContext. Type: LambdaEvent from 'hono/aws-lambda'. Bindings: { event: LambdaEvent }. Deprecated (before v3.10.0): ApiGatewayRequestContext type, c.env.requestContext. Migration: update to use event.requestContext pattern. Questions: How do I access request context? What changed in v3.10.0? How do I migrate from old pattern?

Lambda response streaming with streamHandle. Config: invokeMode: lambda.InvokeMode.RESPONSE_STREAM in FunctionUrl. Import: streamHandle from 'hono/aws-lambda', streamText from 'hono/streaming'. Handler: export const handler = streamHandle(app). Usage: app.get('/stream', async (c) => streamText(c, async (stream) => {...})). Stream methods: stream.writeln(), stream.sleep(). Benefit: traditional Hono streaming without awslambda.streamifyResponse. Questions: How do I enable streaming? How do I implement streamText? What are stream methods?
